title: Publish refuses the tracked fixture roots under _tools/fixtures for good while sync never checks tree causes, so three commits since the last publish block it
goal: kbpublic.tree_refusals and history_refusals read a _root.md under _tools/fixtures as a test input and not as a root; kbpublic.range_tree_causes(up, cwd, rev='HEAD') returns the tree causes of UP..REV as history_refusals gives them, and sync's gate prints each as refused beside the leak causes, so publish passes the range since refs/kb/published when sync does

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbpublic as k;n=len(k.tree_refusals('HEAD',k.tree_files('HEAD','.'),'.'));print('publish tree refusal causes at HEAD that sync never reports:',n);sys.exit(1 if n else 0)

import sys,os,subprocess as s,tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbpublic as k
d=tempfile.mkdtemp();g=lambda *a:s.run(['git','-C',d,*a],check=True,capture_output=True)
rev=lambda:s.run(['git','-C',d,'rev-parse','HEAD'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
g('init','-q')
def w(p,t):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(d+'/'+p),exist_ok=True);open(d+'/'+p,'w').write(t)
def cm(m):
    g('add','-A');g('-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t'+chr(64)+'example.com','commit','-qm',m);return rev()
R='---\nroot: x\nid_prefix: X\nvisibility: internal\ndescription: x\n---\n'
w('a','x\n');b0=cm('base')
w('_tools/fixtures/lang/de/_root.md',R);w('_tools/fixtures/lang/de/a.md','x\n');b1=cm('fixture')
f=k.tree_files('HEAD',d);t=k.tree_refusals('HEAD',f,d);h=k.history_refusals('HEAD',b0,f,d,projected=False)
ok1=not t and not h[0]
w('kb/team/_root.md',R);w('kb/team/a.md','x\n');b2=cm('team')
f=k.tree_files('HEAD',d);t2=k.tree_refusals('HEAD',f,d)
ok2=any('kb/team' in x for x in t2) and not any('fixtures' in x for x in t2)
w('_tools/fixtures/lang/de/b.md','key '+'AKIA'+'A'*16+'\n');b3=cm('secret')
f=k.tree_files('HEAD',d);h3=k.history_refusals('HEAD',b2,f,d,projected=False)
ok3=bool(h3[1])
print(ok1,ok2,ok3)
sys.exit(0 if ok1 and ok2 and ok3 else 1)

notes: Review gap G1 of SP-n7zxspch (S2). Not introduced by the sprint: the old == internal test already refused these roots. Eleven tracked _tools/fixtures/{evidence,lang,placeholders}/*/_root.md say visibility: internal. Commits e184c36f0b, bf104a9dfc and 120bfd99fc (2026-10-28) write under them after refs/kb/published (2026-10-27), so publish refuses that range for good whatever HEAD holds. kg_sync.py:842 runs range_leaks only (leak causes), never the tree check, so sync passes them. Code: kbpublic.py:500-524 tree_refusals, :894-905 the under causes. Fix options: drop _tools/fixtures from the projection, or make sync report tree causes too. The operator decides how publish handles the existing range.
